review: Independent read-only collector review under SM-AUTO-007
runtime: Internal disabled collector; not scheduled/deployed. No readiness claim. No cloud calls/tests/index/source edits. Lead owns suite execution.

findings.title: Transient failed windows cannot be retried
findings.evidence: A durable failed report is created at deterministic scope-derived run ID, then both duplicate checks return for any existing report including failed.
findings.trigger: Monitoring returns transient 429/503; next same-window attempt after recovery returns duplicate failed without provider fetch.
findings.impact: Failed window remains permanently missing unless scope/identity changes or run document is modified.
findings.recommendedFix: Separate immutable attempt records from successful idempotency key or support fenced retry of failed state; preserve successful snapshot/checkpoint.
findings.recommendedValidation: First attempt 429 then same scope succeeds; successful repeated run never re-fetches.

findings.title: Watermark advances across uncollected gaps
findings.evidence: Existing checkpoint rejects only cursor >= scope.to; scope.from is never compared with prior cursor.
findings.trigger: After successful window ending 10:00, collect 11:00-12:00; 10:00-11:00 can be skipped and cursor advances to 12:00.
findings.impact: Checkpoint cannot represent contiguous collected-through history; later original gap is rejected as superseded.
findings.recommendedFix: Define contiguous cursor/initial window semantics and require next window to start at checkpoint, or separate latest queried window from contiguous progress and support backfill.
findings.recommendedValidation: Disjoint future window cannot advance contiguous watermark; gap can be recovered.

findings.title: Identity gate validates configuration presence only
findings.evidence: MANAGER_COLLECTOR_SERVICE_ACCOUNT truthiness is checked but never matched against credential principal; admin initializes default credential and googleRead uses it.
findings.trigger: Enabled process supplies arbitrary nonempty service-account label while executing under different default principal.
findings.impact: Configured identity label does not prove dedicated least-privilege reader. Disabled current runtime prevents current exposure.
findings.recommendedFix: Before enabling, bind deployment principal to approved collector service account and attest actual identity; document trusted deployment-only invariant or implement safe principal verification.
findings.recommendedValidation: Wrong principal cannot collect when enabled; remote enable remains separate approval.

findings.title: Noncanonical timestamp strings misorder checkpoint comparisons
findings.evidence: scope accepts ISO timestamps without canonical normalization; cursor >= scope.to compares text rather than parsed instants.
findings.trigger: Cursor 2026-10-04T10:00:00Z and later end 2026-10-04T10:00:00.500Z compare lexically in wrong chronological order because Z sorts after dot.
findings.impact: Legitimate later fractional-second window may be rejected; equivalent timestamp representations give distinct run IDs.
findings.recommendedFix: Normalize accepted dates to canonical UTC precision and compare numeric instants; canonicalize deterministic identity inputs.
findings.recommendedValidation: Equivalent timestamps yield same identity; fractional-second later cursor compares chronologically.

positiveEvidence: Token plus lease revision and server readTime expiry fence transactions; stale worker release does not clear successor token.
Success checkpoint/snapshot/status commit atomically through transaction callback; provider calls remain outside retried callback.
Failed provider statuses do not advance checkpoint; incomplete Monitoring page token is rejected as partial.
Collector suppresses logs and persists only metric/provenance/freshness surface.
Provider failures and unavailable resource mappings preserve null metrics with explicit state.
limitations: No tests executed; source findings require lead validation.
Current static-resource allowlist covers only three verified apps.
Empty response is accepted complete; before scheduling define ingestion delay/overlap reconciliation so eventual Monitoring data is not frozen as final.
Provenance records resource/query version but not mapping revision/actual executing identity; future contract should define required audit fields.
result: CHANGES_REQUESTED for future enable/scheduling; current disabled status retained
